text: Guided by Social Cognitive Theory and the Transtheoretical Model, this study examined differences in physical activity (PA) determinants, 24-h movement behaviors, and cardiovascular fitness (CRF) across stages of change among Chinese college students. Associations between PA determinants, movement behaviors, and CRF were also examined.
source_label: Physical activity determinants, 24-h movement behaviors, and cardiovascular fitness in young adults: an integrated theoretical model perspective
